title: Keto Pork Tenderloin Tajine
description: A flavorful and spicy keto dish made with tenderloin, algerian spices and tomatoes.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together the Algerian Tajine Spice Mix, salt and black pepper.
3. Rub the spice mix all over the pork tenderloin.
4. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Sear the pork tenderloin for 2-3 minutes on each side.
6. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
7. While the pork is cooking, heat the melted tomato paste in a small saucepan over medium heat.
8. Add the chopped cilantro and minced garlic (if using) to the tomato paste and stir to combine.
9. Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
10. Serve the sliced pork with the tomato and cilantro sauce spooned over the top.
